items.quote: I found Myles on Google to put up a wall mount for my tv and he did a great job! It looks really good and he was very professional about it. Very nice guy I would definitely recommend him to others and will be contacting him for any other projects I need help with. Thank you Myles!

Myles did a fantastic job fixing the fascia on my garage and porch, realigning my fence gate and fixing a hanging outdoor light. His prices were very fair and Myles is very smart, conscientious and meticulous at any job he does.

Myles truly is a lifesaver. I've put together my fair share of furniture but this time, while assembling a couch, I hit a roadblock. Frustrated with limited options, I reached out to Myles on a Sunday afternoon for help.
